scope: Web pages open in a window the app owns, so most people no longer need the browser extension. Email can now work through Thunderbird.

topics.title: Embedded Edge is the usual browser
details: Web pages now open in embedded Edge. This is a browser window the app owns. It does not need the browser extension.
If embedded Edge cannot start, the app uses its own Firefox and tells you.
Google does not allow signing in to a Google account in embedded Edge. For a site that needs Google sign-in, say Use Firefox.
If you already chose a browser, your choice stays. If you linked your own browser with the extension, the app keeps using it. Say Which browser to hear the one in use.

topics.title: Email through Thunderbird
details: You can now use email through Thunderbird. Thunderbird is a free email program. Your helper adds your email account to it once.
To start, say Add account, then choose Thunderbird. You can read, reply, send, move and delete mail the same way as before.
Keep Thunderbird open while you use email. If it is closed, the app asks you to open it.
Your helper can find the steps in EMAIL SETUP - Helper.

topics.title: Your settings are safe
details: Your settings and speech choices are saved in a safer way. If the computer turns off while saving, your old settings stay.

topics.title: Your words are kept
details: On the main menu, a sentence such as Help with the dishes is no longer taken as writing. It only becomes text when a document, email or note is open.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
